mapper.sql: id, sample_id, from_status, to_status, changed_by, changed_at, reason
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sample_status_history (sample_id, from_status, to_status, changed_by, changed_at, reason) VALUES (#{sampleId}, #{fromStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{toStatus}, #{changedBy}, #{changedAt}, #{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sample_status_history WHERE sample_id = #{sampleId} ORDER BY changed_at, id
